questions.question: What does David ask God to do at the start of Psalm 4?
options: Grant him great wealth and honor

questions.question: What does David say the LORD has put in his heart?
options: Longer life than the patriarchs of old
More joy than abundant grain and wine
Greater wealth than the kings of the earth
Wider fame than the nations around
questions.answer: More joy than abundant grain and wine

questions.question: David said, 'In peace I will both lie down and sleep,' for the LORD makes him dwell in safety.
The LORD has set apart the _____ for himself.
